_readme: Product catalogue for scripts/catalogue/import-catalogue.mjs: one entry per product photo in public/assets/sample_images. Flavour, size, servings and label facts are as printed on each pack; price null = not set. Categories are provisional. Re-run the import after editing: existing SKUs are updated, not duplicated, and --prune deactivates backend products and categories that are not listed here.

products.name: Isolate Whey
products.shortDescription: Pure whey protein isolate: 25 g protein with 0 g carbs and 0 g sugar per serving.
products.description:
HV Isolate Whey is a pure whey protein isolate made for lean muscle and faster recovery. Every serving gives you 25 g of protein with zero carbs and zero sugar, so it fits easily into a cutting phase or a clean, high-protein diet.

It comes in a rich Double Rich Chocolate flavour, in a 1 kg tub with 33+ servings.
products.usage: Add one serving to cold water or milk and shake until smooth. Have it after training or between meals to help you reach your daily protein target. Follow the serving size and directions printed on the pack.

products.name: Gold Standard 100% Whey
products.shortDescription: A 100% whey blend of isolate, hydrolysed and concentrate whey, with 25 g protein and 5.5 g BCAAs per serving.
benefits: For muscle building and faster recovery
products.description:
Gold Standard 100% Whey combines three forms of whey protein: isolate, hydrolysed whey and concentrate. Each serving delivers 25 g of protein and 5.5 g of BCAAs, plus 3 g of added vitamins and minerals.

Made for muscle building and faster recovery, in a Double Rich Chocolate flavour. 1 kg tub, 33+ servings.
products.usage: Add one serving to cold water or milk and shake until smooth. Have it after training or between meals to help you reach your daily protein target. Follow the serving size and directions printed on the pack.

products.shortDescription: Advanced high-protein formula with digestive support: 24 g protein, 5.5 g BCAAs and 4 g glutamine per serving.
products.description:

Chocolate Milkshake flavour, in a 2 kg tub with 54 servings.
products.usage: Add one serving to cold water or milk and shake until smooth. Have it after training or between meals to help you reach your daily protein target. Follow the serving size and directions printed on the pack.

products.name: Platinum Whey Protein
products.shortDescription: Hydrolysed, isolate and concentrate whey with 29.5 g protein in every 30 g scoop.
benefits: No added creatine, EAA or BCAA mix
products.description:
Platinum Whey Protein brings together hydrolysed, isolate and concentrate whey. Every 30 g scoop gives 29.5 g of protein.

It is made clean: no added creatine, no EAA or BCAA mix, no amino spiking, no banned substances and no added sugar, so the protein on the label is the protein you get. Unflavoured, 1 kg.
products.usage: Add one 30 g scoop to water or milk and shake well. Unflavoured, so it also mixes into smoothies or oats. Follow the directions printed on the pack.

products.name: BCAA 2:1:1
products.shortDescription: Branched chain amino acids in a 2:1:1 ratio of leucine, isoleucine and valine.
benefits: Leucine, isoleucine and valine in a 2:1:1 ratio
products.description:
BCAA 2:1:1 gives you the three branched chain amino acids, leucine, isoleucine and valine, in the classic 2:1:1 ratio. It helps muscle recovery and reduces muscle breakdown during hard training.

A premium instant mix that dissolves easily for quick absorption. 300 g tub.
products.usage: Mix one serving in water and drink it before, during or after training. Follow the serving size and directions printed on the pack.

products.name: EAA + BCAA
products.shortDescription: Essential amino acids plus branched chain amino acids, in a refreshing Lemon Lime flavour.
products.description:
EAA + BCAA combines all the essential amino acids with branched chain amino acids in one drink. It supports muscle recovery, reduces muscle breakdown and helps you keep going through long sessions.

Lemon Lime flavour, 300 g tub with 55 servings.
products.usage: Mix one serving in water and drink it before, during or after training. Follow the serving size and directions printed on the pack. Food supplement for healthy adults. Not a substitute for a varied, balanced diet.

products.description:
Glutamine is pure L-glutamine powder. It supports muscle recovery, helps reduce muscle breakdown, and supports immune and gut health, especially during heavy training.

300 g tub with 60 servings.
products.usage: Mix one serving in water and drink it before, during or after training. Follow the serving size and directions printed on the pack. Food supplement for healthy adults. Not a substitute for a varied, balanced diet.

products.name: Creatine Monohydrate
products.shortDescription: 100% pure creatine monohydrate: 3 g per serving, with no sugar or fillers.
products.description:
Creatine Monohydrate is 100% pure creatine monohydrate, one of the most studied supplements for strength and power. Each serving gives 3 g of creatine with no sugar and no fillers.

Made for more strength, more power, more muscle and faster recovery. 100 g tub.
products.usage: Mix one 3 g serving in water or juice once a day, every day, including rest days. Drink plenty of water through the day. Follow the directions printed on the pack. Food supplement for healthy adults. Not a substitute for a varied, balanced diet.
